pairs.subject: conversation-orchestration
pairs.evidence: src/components/tour/TourCaptionCard.tsx:79 The tour's narration is a fixed i18n key per scripted step (TourNarrationKey in src/lib/tour-script.ts, with pre-recorded audio), and nothing in it is a model-driven conversation. The subject's precondition, a resident companion running model turns with memory, does not hold here: a case-insensitive grep of src/components/tour for anthropic, openai, completion, recall and chat found 0 files.

techniques.evidence: src/components/tour/TourSpotlight.tsx:25 This is the onboarding tour that dims the page. The technique carves this out under 'when the user has never seen the product, first-run teaching wants the dimming tour'. No turn starts a walkthrough here.

src/components/tour/TourCaptionCard.tsx:68 Athena appears only inside the tour caption card, so she is not a permanent presence, and there are no turn events to drive state. Her layers (an idle video loop plus an audio-reactive canvas) follow the voice level, not a turn lifecycle.
src/components/tour/TourBridgeCard.tsx:29 The end-of-tour bridge offer is fixed copy that navigates when accepted. No model proposes it.

src/components/tour/TourRecapCard.tsx:11 The recap is an ephemeral count built from the tour's own signals. There is no persisted conversation record to write a trail into, which is the technique's 'conversation is ephemeral' carve-out.
src/components/tour/AthenaCompanion.tsx:13 Narration is pre-recorded audio plus scripted captions. No model output exists to lift beats out of.
src/components/tour/TourCaptionCard.tsx:36 The tour has one surface (the caption card) and no chat or ambient pair to route between.

pairs.registryProposal: The tour's avatar realizes the ambient layer (a pre-rendered idle loop) and the reactive layer (an audio-reactive canvas) of layered-avatar-state-machine outside any companion. That technique could note that the layering applies to a scripted narrator presence even where no turn-event state machine exists.
